sendMode.description: 出站模式：off=只听不说（默认）；direct=尚未实现，发送返回 not_implemented

en.description: Outbound mode: off (default) only listens; direct is not implemented yet and returns not_implemented.

maxLength.description: 单条弹幕最多字符数（默认 50，为后续 direct 发送预留）

en.description: Maximum characters per danmaku (default 50; reserved for future direct sending).

maxChunks.description: 一次回复最多拆成几条弹幕（默认 2）

en.description: Maximum danmaku per reply (default 2).

minSendIntervalSec.description: 两次回复的最小间隔（秒），最小 2

en.description: Minimum seconds between two replies, at least 2.

signerUrl.description: 可选：外部签名服务（GET ?stub=<X-MS-STUB> 返回 signature）。本包不内置平台签名脚本；不填时不带签名连接，平台可能拒绝

en.description: Optional external signer (GET ?stub=<X-MS-STUB> returns the signature). The package ships no platform signing script; without it the socket connects unsigned and the platform may refuse.

master.description: 框架 master（抖音 user id）。endpoints[i].master 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Framework masters (Douyin user id). endpoints[i].master can override this value.
Trusted Douyin user ID

trusted.description: 框架 trusted 用户列表（抖音 user id）

en.description: Framework trusted users (Douyin user id).

commandPrefix.description: 命令前缀（默认 '' 无前缀，任意文本按命令匹配；如 '/' 要求 / 开头）。endpoints[i] 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Command prefix. The default empty string allows unprefixed commands; '/' requires a leading slash. Each endpoints[i] can override it.

endpoints.description: 多账号：一个插件实例挂多个 endpoint。每项与顶层字段同构（id 必填，其余覆盖顶层）

id.description: Endpoint 名称（本地标识，不是抖音账号）

en.description: Local endpoint name, not a Douyin account ID.

cookie.description: 浏览器 Cookie 整串（请用 ${DOUYIN_LIVE_COOKIE} 注入，切勿写入仓库）。不填时启动时申请游客 ttwid

en.description: Full browser cookie string. Reference ${DOUYIN_LIVE_COOKIE}; never commit it. Omit to request a guest ttwid at startup.

roomId.description: 直播间 web_rid（live.douyin.com/ 后面的数字）；只填你自己的直播间

en.description: Live room web_rid (the number after live.douyin.com/); use your own room only.
